questions.question_english:
Read the following statements regarding the concept of 'Distributed Leadership' in educational institutions:
I. Leadership practice is co-constructed through the dynamic interactions between leaders, followers, and their situational context.
II. It acknowledges that leadership influence is exercised across multiple individuals (both formal and informal), rather than residing solely with the Principal.
III. It centralizes all strategic decision-making power strictly in the hands of the single Head of School.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). The Distributed Leadership framework (developed by James Spillane and Peter Gronn) reframes leadership from an individual, heroic attribute located in a single formal leader to an emergent, interactive property of the entire organizational system. Statement I is correct because distributed leadership posits that leadership practice takes shape in the mutual interactions among leaders, followers, and the tools/situation. Statement II is correct because it explicitly recognizes that leadership tasks and influence are distributed among teachers, subject heads, and staff members across the school. Statement III is incorrect because centralizing all power in the principal represents autocratic or centralized bureaucratic leadership, which directly contradicts the decentralized, shared ethos of distributed leadership.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। जेम्स स्पिलेन और पीटर ग्रोन द्वारा प्रतिपादित 'वितरित नेतृत्व' (Distributed Leadership) मॉडल यह मानता है कि नेतृत्व किसी अकेले व्यक्ति का एकाधिकार नहीं है, बल्कि यह पूरे विद्यालयी तंत्र में फैला हुआ एक सहयोगात्मक अभ्यास है। कथन I सही है क्योंकि यह सिद्धांत मानता है कि नेतृत्व का अभ्यास नेताओं, अनुयायियों और उनकी परिस्थिति की अंतःक्रिया से पैदा होता है। कथन II सही है क्योंकि यह स्वीकार करता है कि शिक्षक, विभाग प्रमुख और अन्य कर्मचारी भी विद्यालय में नेतृत्वकारी भूमिका निभाते हैं। कथन III गलत है क्योंकि समस्त शक्तियों को विद्यालय प्रमुख में केंद्रित करना 'केंद्रीकृत नौकरशाही' का लक्षण है, जो वितरित नेतृत्व की मूल भावना के सर्वथा विपरीत है। अतः केवल कथन I और II सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II only

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Distributed Leadership views leadership as an interactive practice generated among leaders, followers, and situational contexts, rather than a monopoly held by the principal. It recognizes that leadership influence is shared across multiple stakeholders, including teachers and staff. Centralizing all authority in a single administrator contradicts distributed principles, confirming that statements I and II are correct.

questions.question_english: In educational institutional planning and resource governance, the 'Principle of Optimum Utilization' mandates that administrators must:
options_english: Procure costly capital infrastructure and technology every academic session regardless of existing functional utility
Ensure the maximal and effective deployment of existing physical, instructional, and human assets before requisitioning additional resources
Dedicate one hundred percent of instructional hours strictly to scholastic academic subjects while abolishing physical education
Allocate institutional monetary funds primarily toward aesthetic external facade enhancements rather than academic resources
questions.explanation_english:
The Principle of Optimum Utilization is a cornerstone of institutional planning in educational management. It dictates that an institution must critically assess, mobilize, and fully exhaust the potential of its currently available resources—including physical facilities (laboratories, libraries, playgrounds), instructional media, and teaching and non-teaching personnel—before making financial demands for new infrastructure, staff, or governmental grants. This principle promotes fiscal prudence, avoids resource redundancy, and maximizes institutional productivity within prevailing budgetary constraints.
- Option A is incorrect because acquiring new equipment without exhausting existing capacity leads to wasteful capital expenditure and financial mismanagement.
- Option C is incorrect because eliminating physical education and co-curricular pursuits violates the holistic development aims of modern educational policy.
- Option D is incorrect because prioritizing cosmetic architectural facades over core pedagogical and human resources undermines educational quality.
questions.explanation_hindi:
संस्थागत नियोजन में 'इष्टतम उपयोगिता का सिद्धांत' यह स्पष्ट करता है कि किसी भी विद्यालय या शैक्षणिक संस्था को नए बजट, अनुदान अथवा अतिरिक्त संसाधनों की मांग करने से पहले अपने पास उपलब्ध समस्त भौतिक संसाधनों (जैसे कक्षा-कक्ष, पुस्तकालय, प्रयोगशालाएं, खेल का मैदान) और मानव संसाधनों (शिक्षकों और कर्मचारियों की क्षमता) का पूर्ण, युक्तिसंगत और कार्यकुशल उपयोग करना चाहिए। यह सिद्धांत अपव्यय को रोकता है, उपलब्ध संसाधनों की दक्षता को उच्चतम स्तर तक ले जाता है और सीमित वित्तीय साधनों में अधिकतम शैक्षणिक परिणाम प्राप्त करने में सहायता करता है।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि मौजूदा संसाधनों का उपयोग किए बिना नई वस्तुएं खरीदना वित्तीय अनुशासनहीनता है।
- विकल्प (C) गलत है क्योंकि खेल और सह-पाठ्यचर्या को समाप्त करना सर्वांगीण विकास के शैक्षणिक लक्ष्यों के विरुद्ध है।
- विकल्प (D) गलत है क्योंकि शैक्षणिक गुणवत्ता को दरकिनार कर केवल बाहरी दिखावे पर धन व्यय करना अनुचित प्रबंधकीय प्राथमिकता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Making effective use of existing physical and human resources before demanding more.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Principle of Optimum Utilization in institutional planning emphasizes maximizing the efficiency and productivity of existing physical, educational, and human resources before demanding additional government funds or infrastructure. By assessing local capacity, optimizing time-table schedules, and utilizing available equipment effectively, administrators ensure prudent resource management and cost-effective educational operations.

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): In Fiedler’s Contingency Model, a leader’s LPC (Least Preferred Co-worker) score is considered flexible and easily changed depending on the situation.
Reason (R): Fiedler believed that leadership style is a reflection of personality, which is relatively stable and fixed.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). In Fiedler’s Contingency Model, an individual’s Least Preferred Co-worker (LPC) score is viewed as a stable personality trait that remains relatively fixed rather than easily flexible. Fiedler believed leadership orientation reflects underlying personality structure, making it resistant to rapid change. Because individual leadership styles are relatively rigid, Fiedler argued that organizational effectiveness is achieved by matching the leader to the situation or changing the situational favorableness (job engineering), not by trying to change the leader's style. Thus, Assertion (A) is false, while Reason (R) is true.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। अभिकथन (A) असत्य है क्योंकि फ्रेड फिडलर के आकस्मिकता मॉडल में किसी नेता के एलपीसी (LPC) स्कोर को एक स्थिर और स्थायी व्यक्तित्व लक्षण माना जाता है, जिसे स्थिति के अनुसार बदला नहीं जा सकता। फिडलर का मानना था कि किसी नेता की बुनियादी नेतृत्व शैली को बदलना कठिन होता है, इसलिए नेतृत्व प्रभावशीलता बढ़ाने के लिए स्थिति को नेता के अनुकूल बनाना चाहिए (Job Engineering) अथवा स्थिति के अनुसार सही शैली वाले नेता का चयन करना चाहिए। कारण (R) बिल्कुल सही है क्योंकि फिडलर का यह स्पष्ट तर्क था कि नेतृत्व शैली अंतर्निहित व्यक्तित्व का प्रकटीकरण है, जो अपेक्षाकृत स्थायी व स्थिर होती है। अतः A गलत है परन्तु R सही है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In Fiedler’s Contingency Model, an individual’s Least Preferred Co-worker (LPC) score is viewed as a stable personality trait that remains relatively fixed rather than easily flexible. Fiedler believed leadership orientation reflects underlying personality structure, making it resistant to rapid change. Thus, asserting the LPC score changes easily is false, while recognizing Fiedler’s view of fixed personality traits is accurate.

questions.question_english: Contingency theories of leadership fundamentally propose that:
options_english: Leadership effectiveness depends on matching a leader's style to situational variables.
Universal leadership principles dictate that there is always one best administrative way to lead across all organizational situations.
Leadership capacity is entirely dependent on the inherent genetic traits, biological features, and innate personality of the leader.
Leaders must constantly alter their core personality characteristics and fundamental beliefs to match the expectations of followers.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). Contingency theories of leadership propose that no single leadership style is universally effective across all organizational scenarios. Instead, leadership effectiveness depends on matching a leader's behavioral orientation with specific situational characteristics, such as task complexity, leader authority, and group maturity. Successful management requires diagnosing environmental factors and adjusting leadership approaches or placing leaders in situations that align with their strengths. Option (b) reflects classical universalist assumptions. Option (c) describes Trait Theory. Option (d) contradicts leadership theory regarding the stability of core personality.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। नेतृत्व के आकस्मिकता सिद्धांतों का मुख्य प्रस्ताव यह है कि नेतृत्व की कोई भी शैली सभी परिस्थितियों में सार्वभौमिक रूप से प्रभावी नहीं होती। इसके बजाय, नेतृत्व की प्रभावशीलता इस बात पर निर्भर करती है कि नेता की व्यवहार शैली और विशिष्ट परिस्थितिजन्य विशेषताओं (जैसे कार्य की जटिलता, नेता का अधिकार और समूह की परिपक्वता) के बीच कितना उपयुक्त सामंजस्य है। सफल प्रबंधन के लिए पर्यावरण का निदान करके सही नेता को सही परिस्थिति में पदस्थापित करना आवश्यक होता है। विकल्प (b) सार्वभौमिक दृष्टिकोण है। विकल्प (c) शीलगुण सिद्धांत का मत है। विकल्प (d) मनोवैज्ञानिक रूप से अवास्तविक है।

questions.question_english: In educational management and human resource development, what is the primary purpose of conducting a 'Needs Assessment' before planning a Staff Development program?
options_english: To identify discrepancies and gaps between teachers' existing skills and required pedagogical competencies
To systematically exhaust all allocated institutional training grant budgets before the end of the financial year
To formally identify underperforming teachers in order to penalize them with adverse performance appraisals
To compile administrative documentation to justify a formal budget increase for physical school infrastructure
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). A Needs Assessment is a diagnostic administrative tool used to systematically determine the discrepancies between current instructional performance ('what is') and required pedagogical standards or institutional goals ('what should be'). By diagnosing these skill gaps, administrators can design customized, evidence-based staff development programs that directly address teachers' authentic professional challenges, thereby enhancing instructional delivery. Option (b) is incorrect because budget exhaustion is an administrative procedure, not a pedagogical justification. questions.question_english: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT regarding 'Accountability' in educational administration and governance?

A school principal can delegate operational authority to staff, but can never completely delegate ultimate legal accountability
Accountability represents the mandatory institutional obligation of an administrator to report on performance outcomes
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). In administrative law and management theory, a foundational canon dictates: 'Authority can be delegated, but Accountability can NEVER be delegated.' While a superior can delegate operational tasks and commensurate authority to a subordinate, the superior remains perpetually answerable to higher authorities for the overall execution and final outcome of those tasks. Therefore, the assertion that accountability can be fully transferred and relinquished to a subordinate is incorrect. Option (b) is a factually correct statement: accountability inherently flows upwards because subordinates answer to their superiors. Option (c) is a factually correct statement: a principal retains ultimate legal accountability for the school. Option (d) is a factually correct statement: accountability fundamentally denotes the obligation to report and justify institutional results.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रशासनिक और प्रबंधन सिद्धांत का यह सार्वभौमिक नियम है कि 'प्राधिकार और कार्य का तो प्रत्यायोजन हो सकता है, परंतु अंतिम जवाबदेही का कभी भी प्रत्यायोजन या हस्तांतरण नहीं किया जा सकता।' यदि एक प्रधानाचार्य किसी शिक्षक को परीक्षा संचालन का कार्य सौंपता है, तो भी शिक्षा विभाग और सरकार के प्रति अंतिम रूप से जवाबदेह प्रधानाचार्य ही बना रहता है; वह यह कहकर जिम्मेदारी से नहीं बच सकता कि कार्य शिक्षक को सौंपा गया था। अतः विकल्प (a) गलत कथन होने के कारण सही उत्तर है। विकल्प (b) सही कथन है क्योंकि जवाबदेही हमेशा पदसोपान में नीचे से ऊपर की ओर जाती है। विकल्प (c) सही कथन है क्योंकि अंतिम विधिक जिम्मेदारी प्रधानाचार्य की ही होती है। विकल्प (d) सही कथन है क्योंकि परिणामों का हिसाब देना ही जवाबदेही है।

Read the following leadership styles of the Hersey-Blanchard model:
I. Participating

IV. Delegating

Which of the following represents the correct sequence from lowest follower maturity (M1) to highest follower maturity (M4)?

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). The Hersey-Blanchard Situational Leadership model progression maps leadership styles directly to increasing follower readiness from M1 to M4: for low readiness (M1), Telling (III) is used; for low-to-moderate readiness (M2), Selling (II) is applied; for moderate-to-high readiness (M3), Participating (I) is adopted; and for high readiness (M4), Delegating (IV) is utilized. Therefore, the sequence from M1 to M4 is III, II, I, IV. Options (b), (c), and (d) disrupt this progression.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (a) है। हर्शी-ब्लैंचर्ड स्थितिजन्य नेतृत्व सिद्धांत में अनुयायी की परिपक्वता (तत्परता स्तर) के बढ़ने के साथ नेतृत्व शैलियों का सही क्रम इस प्रकार है:
1. M1 (अक्षम और अनिच्छुक) -> S1: निदेशन/टेलिंग (III)
2. M2 (अक्षम किन्तु इच्छुक) -> S2: विक्रय/सेलिंग (II)
3. M3 (सक्षम किन्तु अनिच्छुक/असुरक्षित) -> S3: सहभागिता/पार्टिसिपेटिंग (I)

अतः M1 से M4 का सही विकासात्मक क्रम III, II, I, IV है। अन्य सभी विकल्प इस स्थापित क्रम का उल्लंघन करते हैं।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Hersey-Blanchard model progression maps leadership styles directly to increasing follower readiness from M1 to M4. For low readiness (M1), the Telling style is used. As readiness increases to moderate levels (M2 and M3), leaders transition to Selling and Participating styles, respectively. Finally, for high readiness (M4), where followers possess high ability and willingness, the Delegating style is applied.

questions.question_english: A Principal faces a crisis where the school building is rapidly flooding due to torrential rains and immediate evacuation is necessary. According to leadership theories, which approach is most appropriate despite the Principal’s normally democratic nature?
options_english: Convening an urgent general staff meeting to collaboratively build consensus regarding optimal evacuation routes (Participative)
Immediately issuing clear, non-negotiable instructions on evacuation (Directive/Authoritarian)
Allowing individual teachers full autonomy to determine and execute their own evacuation strategies (Laissez-faire)

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). In life-threatening emergency situations requiring immediate action, contingency and situational leadership theories dictate that directive and authoritarian leadership becomes imperative. Prolonged consultation, consensus-building, or delegation introduces delays and confusion when rapid execution is critical for life safety. Issuing immediate, clear, non-negotiable instructions ensures decisive coordination, safety compliance, and effective crowd management. Option (a) is incorrect because participative consensus-seeking wastes precious time during an imminent crisis. Option (c) is incorrect because a laissez-faire approach causes uncoordinated chaos. Option (d) is incorrect because students lack the authority, training, and emergency readiness to manage institutional evacuations.

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). questions.question_english: In institutional planning and educational financial management, the concept of 'Zero-Based Budgeting' (ZBB) implies that:
options_english: The institution must expend all allocated fiscal grants completely so that exactly zero funds remain at fiscal year-end
Current budget allocations are mechanically calculated by adjusting previous fiscal year expenditures strictly for inflation
Every proposed expenditure must be freshly justified and constructed from a zero baseline for each new budget cycle
All non-academic, co-curricular, and extracurricular funding allocations are permanently eliminated from institutional accounts
questions.explanation_english:
Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB), conceptualized by Peter Pyhrr in the 1970s, is a budgeting method that requires all expenses to be justified for each new financial period starting from a 'zero base', rather than incrementally adjusting prior years' budgets. In educational institutions, administrators using ZBB do not assume that existing programs or expenditure lines should automatically continue. Instead, every department and activity must present a functional justification, demonstrate cost-benefit efficacy, and evaluate its contribution to the school's strategic objectives before funding is authorized. This eliminates redundant spending, enhances fiscal transparency, and channels resources to high-impact educational priorities.
- Option A is incorrect because spending all funds to avoid a lapse is a symptom of poor traditional budgetary practice ('use-it-or-lose-it' rush), not ZBB.
- Option B is incorrect because incrementally adjusting the previous year's budget for inflation defines 'Incremental Budgeting' or historical budgeting.
- Option D is incorrect because ZBB does not arbitrarily eliminate co-curricular activities; rather, it requires their expenses to be justified on their educational merits.
questions.explanation_hindi:

- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि वित्तीय वर्ष के अंत में बजट लैप्स होने से बचने के लिए हड़बड़ी में खर्च करना गलत वित्तीय परंपरा है, शून्य-आधारित बजट नहीं।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि पिछले बजट में मुद्रास्फीति जोड़ना पारंपरिक 'वृद्धिशील बजट' कहलाता है।
- विकल्प (D) गलत है क्योंकि यह विधि गतिविधियों को मनमाने ढंग से समाप्त नहीं करती, बल्कि उनके शैक्षणिक महत्व के आधार पर धन आवंटित करती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Building budgets from a zero baseline, justifying every proposed expense.

Rather than modifying historical budgets for inflation, administrators evaluate all proposed programs and expenditures on their merits, ensuring cost efficiency, eliminating redundant activities, and reallocating funds to strategic educational priorities.

questions.question_english: The concept of ‘School Climate’ differs from ‘School Culture’ in that School Climate generally refers to:

The specific architectural design, layout, and physical infrastructure facilities available within the school building
The formal statutory rules and legal regulations governing the daily operational functioning of school administration
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). While often used interchangeably in everyday conversation, educational management draws a sharp conceptual distinction between 'School Climate' and 'School Culture'. School Climate refers to the immediate, perceived psychological atmosphere and emotional tone of the school at a specific point in time—encompassing current feelings of safety, morale, interpersonal trust, warmth, and communication among teachers, students, and administration. It can fluctuate and is relatively responsive to short-term administrative interventions. In contrast, School Culture (Option a) represents the deep, historically rooted, enduring beliefs, core philosophies, traditions, and institutional values that evolve over generations and are exceptionally resilient to change. Option (c) refers to physical facilities. Option (d) refers to statutory bylaws.

questions.question_english: A Principal discovers that a highly esteemed veteran teacher has been bypassing the new digital attendance system. questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). Rather than relying on rigid bureaucratic authority, transactional rewards and punishments, or formal disciplinary reprimands, an authentic leader approaches sensitive interpersonal dilemmas with genuine empathy, open dialogue, and moral groundedness. In this case, the Principal's decision to conduct a private, supportive conversation appealing to the senior teacher's professional integrity, personal pride, and status as an esteemed role model for younger colleagues perfectly exemplifies authentic leadership. Option (a), transactional leadership (management by exception), would mechanically issue a formal memo or enforce penalties for non-compliance. Option (b), autocratic leadership, would enforce strict compliance through fear and positional authority. Option (d), laissez-faire leadership, would neglect administrative responsibility entirely and ignore the non-compliance.

questions.explanation_english:
Fred E. Fiedler developed the Contingency Theory of Leadership in the mid-1960s. Fiedler postulated that there is no single best leadership style; rather, a leader's effectiveness depends on the interaction between their leadership style (measured via the Least Preferred Coworker or LPC scale) and the degree to which the situation gives them control and influence (situational favorableness). Fiedler defined situational favorableness using three key variables:
1. Leader-Member Relations: The degree of trust, confidence, and respect subordinates have in the leader.
2. Task Structure: The extent to which tasks and assignments are clearly defined, formalized, and proceduralized.
3. Position Power: The formal authority and legitimate power inherent in the leader's position to reward, discipline, or promote.
- Option A is incorrect because Paul Hersey (along with Ken Blanchard) developed the 'Situational Leadership Theory' based on task behavior, relationship behavior, and follower readiness.
- Option B is incorrect because Robert House developed the 'Path-Goal Theory of Leadership' based on expectancy theory.
- Option C is incorrect because Abraham Maslow formulated the 'Hierarchy of Needs Theory' of human motivation.

1. नेता-सदस्य संबंध: अनुयायियों और नेता के बीच विश्वास, आदर और सद्भाव की स्थिति।
2. कार्य संरचना: कार्य के लक्ष्यों, प्रक्रियाओं और चरणों का स्पष्ट एवं संरचित होना।
3. पद शक्ति: नेता के पद में निहित औपचारिक अधिकार, जिसके तहत वह पुरस्कार या दंड दे सकता है।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि पॉल हर्सी ने केन ब्लैंचर्ड के साथ मिलकर 'परिस्थितिजन्य नेतृत्व मॉडल' विकसित किया था।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि रॉबर्ट हाउस ने 'पथ-लक्ष्य सिद्धांत' का प्रतिपादन किया था।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Fred Fiedler

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Fred Fiedler developed the Contingency Theory of leadership, which evaluates leadership effectiveness by measuring situational favorableness across three dimensions: leader-member relations, task structure, and position power. Fiedler used the Least Preferred Co-worker scale to classify leadership styles, matching task-oriented or relationship-oriented leaders to situations where they are most likely to succeed.

questions.question_english: In Victor Vroom's Expectancy Theory of motivation, what does the core construct 'Valence' refer to?
options_english: The perceived probability that exerting high operational effort will lead to successful task performance
The administrative belief that reaching designated organizational performance targets guarantees receiving a formal reward
The fundamental physiological survival drives and physical safety requirements of an organizational employee
The subjective emotional value, attractiveness, or desirability an individual attaches to a specific reward or outcome
questions.explanation_english:
The correct answer is (d). Victor Vroom's Expectancy Theory models motivation through three distinct components: Motivation = Expectancy × Instrumentality × Valence.
- Expectancy (Effort → Performance): The employee's subjective expectation that putting in effort will result in successful performance. (Option a).
- Instrumentality (Performance → Outcome): The belief that successful performance will be rewarded with a specific outcome. (Option b).
- Valence (V): The perceived affective value, attractiveness, or personal desirability that an individual assigns to the anticipated outcome or reward. Valence can be positive (reward is desired), zero (indifference), or negative (outcome is avoided).
Option (c) pertains to Maslow's physiological needs. Therefore, Option (d) accurately defines Valence.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (d) है। विक्टर व्रूम के अभिप्रेरणा के प्रत्याशा सिद्धांत के अनुसार: Motivation = Expectancy × Instrumentality × Valence।
1. प्रत्याशा (Expectancy): यह विश्वास कि प्रयास करने से कार्य का सफल निष्पादन होगा (प्रयास → निष्पादन)। (विकल्प a)।
2. साधनता (Instrumentality): यह विश्वास कि अच्छा प्रदर्शन करने पर पुरस्कार अवश्य मिलेगा (निष्पादन → प्रतिफल)। (विकल्प b)।
3. संयोजकता (Valence): व्यक्ति द्वारा उस पुरस्कार या परिणाम को दिया गया भावनात्मक महत्व या आकर्षण। यदि कोई शिक्षक किसी पुरस्कार (जैसे प्रशंसा पत्र या पदोन्नति) को बहुत अधिक पसंद करता है, तो उसकी संयोजकता उच्च होगी। यदि वह पुरस्कार के प्रति उदासीन है, तो संयोजकता शून्य होगी।
विकल्प (c) मास्लो की शारीरिक आवश्यकताओं से संबंधित है। अतः सही उत्तर (d) है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The emotional value an individual attaches to a specific reward.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: In Vroom’s Expectancy Theory, Valence refers to the emotional value, desirability, or importance an individual assigns to a potential outcome or reward. Valence ranges from positive to negative depending on personal preferences. If an employee values the offered reward highly, valence is high, contributing positively to overall motivation when expectancy and instrumentality conditions are met.

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R).
Assertion (A): The Behavioral Theory of leadership argues that leaders are born with immutable traits that determine their effectiveness.
Reason (R): Behavioral theories focus on observable actions, implying that leadership skills can be taught and developed.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). Assertion (A) is false because the premise that leaders are born with innate, immutable traits belongs to the Trait Theory (or Great Man Theory) of leadership. In contrast, the Behavioral Theory arose specifically to challenge this notion, emphasizing that leadership is composed of observable behaviors and practices rather than genetic traits. Reason (R) is true because behavioral research (such as the Ohio State and Michigan studies) focuses on actions that can be observed, practiced, taught, and cultivated. Thus, Assertion (A) is false while Reason (R) is true.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। अभिकथन (A) गलत है क्योंकि यह मान्यता कि 'नेता जन्म लेते हैं, बनाए नहीं जाते' और वे अपरिवर्तनीय जन्मजात गुणों से युक्त होते हैं, नेतृत्व के 'विशेषक सिद्धांत' (Trait Theory / Great Man Theory) का मूल तत्व है, व्यवहारवादी सिद्धांत का नहीं। कारण (R) बिल्कुल सही है क्योंकि व्यवहारवादी सिद्धांतों (जैसे ओहायो स्टेट और मिशिगन अध्ययन) ने यह सिद्ध किया कि नेतृत्व विशिष्ट अवलोकनीय क्रियाओं और व्यवहारों का समुच्चय है, जिसका अर्थ यह है कि व्यक्तियों को प्रशिक्षण और अभ्यास के माध्यम से प्रभावी नेता बनाया जा सकता है। अतः A गलत है परन्तु R सही है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Behavioral Theory of leadership contradicts trait theory by asserting that leadership relies on observable actions rather than innate genetic traits. Because behaviors can be learned and developed through training, leadership is not restricted to those born with specific qualities. Thus, claiming behavioral theory views traits as immutable is incorrect, while recognizing that it emphasizes trainable actions accurately reflects behavioral research.

questions.question_english: Which of the following supervisory practices best exemplifies a 'Formative' approach to teacher appraisal?
options_english: Conducting a high-stakes annual evaluation exclusively to decide whether an increment or contract extension is granted
Using external standardized board examination pass rates as the sole quantitative metric of teaching competence
Issuing an administrative show-cause memorandum or formal punitive reprimand following a single pedagogical classroom slip
Conducting periodic developmental classroom observations accompanied by constructive, collaborative feedback
questions.explanation_english:
Appraisal in educational management is classified into formative and summative evaluation. A formative approach focuses on developmental diagnostics, ongoing professional growth, and continuous instructional enhancement. Conducting periodic, non-threatening classroom observations followed by reflective dialogues and constructive feedback allows teachers to identify instructional blind spots, refine pedagogy, and strengthen pedagogical practices in real time without the fear of immediate administrative penalties.
- Option A is incorrect because high-stakes, end-of-year evaluations tied strictly to compensation, contract renewal, or promotions represent 'Summative Appraisal'.
- Option B is incorrect because relying solely on terminal student test results is a summative, quantitative accountability measure that provides no actionable qualitative pedagogical feedback.
- Option C is incorrect because issuing punitive memos for classroom slips represents authoritarian discipline, which undermines psychological safety and professional development.
questions.explanation_hindi:
शैक्षणिक प्रबंधन में मूल्यांकन को रचनात्मक (फॉर्मेटिव) और संकलनात्मक (समेटिव) दृष्टिकोणों में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है। रचनात्मक मूल्यांकन का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य शिक्षक की कमियों को उजागर कर दण्डित करना नहीं, बल्कि उसकी निरंतर व्यावसायिक प्रगति और शिक्षण-अधिगम गुणवत्ता में सुधार करना होता है। समय-समय पर कक्षा का अवलोकन करना, अनुकूल वातावरण में चर्चा करना और सुधारात्मक प्रतिपुष्टि देना रचनात्मक मूल्यांकन की मूल भावना है। इससे शिक्षक बिना किसी प्रशासनिक भय के अपनी शिक्षण विधियों को बेहतर बना सकते हैं।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि वेतन वृद्धि या पदोन्नति के उद्देश्य से सत्र के अंत में किया जाने वाला अंतिम मूल्यांकन 'संकलनात्मक मूल्यांकन' कहलाता है।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि केवल परीक्षा परिणामों के आधार पर शिक्षकों को आंकना एक परिणाम-उन्मुख संकलनात्मक विधि है।
- विकल्प (C) गलत है क्योंकि छोटी-मोटी त्रुटियों पर दंडात्मक नोटिस जारी करना कठोर दंडात्मक नियंत्रण है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Conducting periodic classroom observations to give constructive feedback.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Formative appraisal focuses on continuous professional development, ongoing evaluation, and instructional improvement rather than summative administrative decision-making.
